judge.rationale: The candidate produces the exact same production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and adds a virtually identical unit test to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (even matching the exact test name and line numbers). All acceptance criteria are satisfied, including updating the spec line numbers, documenting what a hook can assume in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and adding the migration note to `CHANGELOG.md`. Minor differences from the reference are that the candidate kept the new guarantee under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in the spec rather than promoting it to the main requirements list, and left behind a `.lore/dod.md` file along with a redundant `.acceptance.test.ts` file.
